title: hieracium caesium subsp. jaubertianum
intro: Hieracium caesium subsp. jaubertianum, commonly known as Cornflower, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family Asteraceae. The plant is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Cornflower are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system and soothe irritated tissues, making it useful for treating anxiety and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cornflower include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, which are responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
